# Playbook: dependency
Use when: add, change or remove a dependency between roadmap items

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user, or skill lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace?" |
| order | the owner's message, quoted verbatim: the speaker says they are the workspace owner and orders this change | STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap`. Say: "There is no owner order, so I can only propose this as a change request; nothing was changed." |
| roadmap | the roadmap title or id that holds both items | STOP. Say: "Which roadmap holds both items?" |
| source | the first item ("A depends on B": A) | STOP. Say: "Which item depends on which?" |
| target | the second item ("A depends on B": B) | STOP. Say: "Which item depends on which?" |
| change | "create", "edit", "reject", "reactivate" or "archive" | STOP. Say: "Create, change or remove the dependency?" |
| type | blocks, depends_on, relates_to, shared_capability or enables_future_use, from the order | "depends_on" for create; else "unchanged" |
| rationale | the owner's reason, verbatim ("Motivo:", "porque"); an archive stores it as the link's rationale | the quoted order |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode, else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
2. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   SAVE: roadmapId = id of the one roadmaps[] entry whose title or id equals <input:roadmap>; sourceId, targetId = ids of the one items[] entry with roadmapId == <saved:roadmapId> whose title or id equals <input:source>, <input:target>
   IF a name matches 0 or 2+ entries → STOP. Say: "Which one do you mean: <the matching titles with ids>? Both items must be in one roadmap."
   SAVE: linkId, linkType, linkStatus = id, type, status of the itemLinks[] entry with sourceItemId == <saved:sourceId> and targetItemId == <saved:targetId> (for reactivate the one with status archived or rejected, else the active one), empty if none
3. IF <input:change> == "create" and <saved:linkStatus> == "active" → SAVE: readBack = "already active: <saved:linkId>"; go to Answer.
   IF <input:change> != "create" and <saved:linkId> is empty → STOP. Say: "No dependency <input:source> → <input:target>. Links between them: <itemLinks[] entries of both, with direction and status>."
   IF <saved:mode> == "enforce" and <input:change> == "create" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap`. Say: "In enforce a new dependency is a change request (changeType link). Nothing was changed."
   SAVE: newType = <input:type>, else <saved:linkType> when "unchanged"; newStatus = "rejected" (reject), "active" (reactivate), "archived" (archive), else <saved:linkStatus>
4. IF <saved:mode> == "enforce" → switch to playbook governance.
   Hand it mode "window", kind "dependency", entityId <saved:linkId>, newValue <saved:newType>, newStatus <saved:newStatus>, rationale <input:rationale>.
   IF <input:change> != "create" → go to step 7.
5. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: create <input:source> <saved:newType> <input:target>?"
   IF the order does not name both items and the direction → ASK: "Create <input:source> <saved:newType> <input:target> in roadmap <saved:roadmapId>? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
6. CALL `create_workspace_roadmap_dependency` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","sourceItemId":"<saved:sourceId>","targetItemId":"<saved:targetId>","type":"<saved:newType>","rationale":"<input:rationale>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<error text>. Nothing was created. A cycle refusal also counts archived and rejected links."
   SAVE: linkId = result.id
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_item_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no entry has id <saved:linkId> and status "active" → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is not listed active."
   SAVE: readBack = "<saved:linkId> <saved:newType> active"
   GO TO Answer
7. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: set dependency <saved:linkId> to <saved:newType>, <saved:newStatus>?"
   IF <input:change> == "reactivate" → ASK: "Reactivate <saved:linkId>? LPM skips duplicate and cycle checks here. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
8. CALL `update_workspace_roadmap_dependency` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","linkId":"<saved:linkId>","type":"<saved:newType>","status":"<saved:newStatus>","rationale":"<input:rationale>"} [O]
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or itemLinks[] entry <saved:linkId> has status != <saved:newStatus> or type != <saved:newType> → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> reads <status>, <type>."
   SAVE: readBack = "<saved:linkId> <saved:newType> <saved:newStatus>"

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:roadmapId> / <saved:sourceId> → <saved:targetId> (mode <saved:mode>); owner order: "<input:order>"
Done: <dependency <saved:linkId>: type <saved:newType>, status <saved:newStatus> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <re-read: <saved:readBack> | none>
Pending: <none | <the change not done>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | undo: this playbook with change reactivate | none>
```
type: blocks | depends_on | relates_to | shared_capability | enables_future_use (read "source type target"); status: active | rejected | archived. Never claim a change that a VERIFY above did not show.
